lines.en: label mikudorm15:
: Hey, Miku. What are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Miku。你现在在干什么？

lines.en: I knock on Miku's door and, almost instantly after doing so, hear the sound of a dresser drawer slamming shut.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Miku 的门，几乎在敲响的瞬间，就听见一个抽屉砰地关上的声音。

lines.en: : Sensei? Is that you bangin’ out there?
lines.zh: : Sensei？是你在外面敲门吗？

lines.en: : Gimme one sec! I’m gettin’ dressed!
lines.zh: : 等我一下！我在穿衣服！

lines.en: : Do you...need help?
lines.zh: : 你……需要帮忙吗？

lines.en: scene momentsredux1
: Nope! All done!
lines.zh: : 不用！好了！

lines.en: : I see you are just as quick at getting changed as you are at...literally everything else.
lines.zh: : 看来你换衣服的速度，跟你做……其他所有事情一样快。

lines.en: : You know it! Just had to put my hoodie on and stuff.
lines.zh: : 那当然！就是把连帽衫套上什么的。

lines.en: : What brings ya over here tonight? Bored of sittin’ at home or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 今晚什么风把你吹来了？在家坐着无聊了之类的？

lines.en: : Something like that. Figured I'd drop by and see if you want to hang out.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。想着顺路来看看你要不要一起玩。

lines.en: scene momentsredux2
: Well, I was just about to go for a jog, but I'd be happy to take ya along if ya want!
lines.zh: : 嗯，我正准备去慢跑，不过你要是想一起，我很乐意带上你！

lines.en: : There is absolutely no way I can keep up with you.
lines.zh: : 我绝对跟不上你。

lines.en: Despite my body {i}appearing{/i} to be in great shape, it is very much {i}not.{/i}
lines.zh: 尽管我的身体{i}看起来{/i}状态很好，实际上却完全{i}不是{/i}那么回事。

lines.en: In fact, even the thought of running is making me tired. Tagging along with Miku would just slow her down.
lines.zh: 事实上，光是想想跑步就让我觉得累。跟着 Miku 跑只会拖慢她。

lines.en: : So, what’ll it be? You gonna run around with me?
lines.zh: : 那么，怎么样？要不要跟我一起跑？

lines.en: : I’ll buy ya a drink if you say yes!
lines.zh: : 你答应我就给你买瓶饮料！

lines.en: : I’m not going to make you buy me a drink, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我不会让你给我买饮料的，Miku。

lines.en: : Why the heck not?! It’s just a drink! It'll give ya one of those, uhh...incentive thingies to come out with me. Did I use that word right?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行啊？！不就是瓶饮料嘛！这样你就有那个……呃……动力的什么玩意儿跟我出来了。我用对词了吗？

lines.en: : More or less. But why do you even want me to come? Won't I get in the way?
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。不过你为什么这么想让我去？我不会碍事吗？

lines.en: scene momentsredux3
: You think I care about that? I don't mind slowin' down to match your pace at all. I just think it sounds fun bein' out at night with somebody.
lines.zh: : 你以为我会在意那个吗？我一点都不介意放慢速度配合你。我只是觉得，晚上和谁一起出来听起来就很有意思。

lines.en: : Pleeeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 求——你了嘛？

lines.en: : Okay, fine. But I'm buying my own drink.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。不过饮料我自己买。

lines.en: scene momentsredux4
: Heck yeah, let's go! Nobody in our class ever wants to jog with me! This is great!
lines.zh: : 太好了，走吧！我们班上没有一个人愿意跟我一起慢跑！这太棒了！

lines.en: scene black
Miku immediately jolts down the hall, playfully punching me in the arm as she passes.
lines.zh: Miku 立刻冲进走廊，经过我身边时还玩笑似的打了我胳膊一拳。

lines.en: Sighing to myself and bracing for what is going to be a much more exhausting night than I anticipated, I follow after her...
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，为这个比我预想的要累得多的夜晚做好准备，然后跟了上去……

lines.en: scene momentsredux5
: Okay! You ready to do this, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 好！准备好开始了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : As ready as I’ll ever be...
lines.zh: : 已经是我能准备到的最好状态了……

lines.en: Miku begins to stretch herself out before taking off and I make a half-hearted attempt to do the same.
lines.zh: Miku 出发前开始拉伸，我也敷衍地试着照做。

lines.en: Her hoodie lifts up each time she bends backwards and I catch a glimpse of her stomach.
lines.zh: 她每次向后弯腰，连帽衫就会掀起来，我便瞥见她的肚子。

lines.en: The moonlight bounces off of it and into my eyes as if to remind me that now is the worst possible time to be thinking of things that may give me an erection.
lines.zh: 月光从那里反射进我的眼睛，仿佛在提醒我：现在是最不该去想那些会让我勃起的事情的时刻。

lines.en: : So, what we’re gonna do is this...
lines.zh: : 那么，我们要这么做……

lines.en: : You run wherever the heck you want and I’ll jog right next to ya. Kay?
lines.zh: : 你想跑哪儿就跑哪儿，我就在你旁边慢跑。好吗？

lines.en: : Wait, really? Isn't there, like...a path you normally take or something?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？你不是有……固定的路线什么的吗？

lines.en: : I don’t want to accidentally run into a dead-end and mess up your pace.
lines.zh: : 我可不想不小心跑进死胡同，打乱你的节奏。

lines.en: scene momentsredux6
: Oh! Good thinkin’!
lines.zh: : 哦！想得周到！

lines.en: : Then, how about...you just try your best to stick next to me and I'll slow down whenever I have to?
lines.zh: : 那么，不如……你尽量跟紧我，我需要的时候就放慢速度？

lines.en: : We don't gotta worry about any dead ends if we stick to my normal route.
lines.zh: : 只要沿着我平时的路线，就不用担心什么死胡同。

lines.en: : And if ya ever feel your legs gettin’ tired or somethin', you can just reach over and tap my shoulder.
lines.zh: : 要是你觉得腿酸了什么的，伸手拍拍我的肩膀就行。

lines.en: : Slowin’ down for one night won’t do much harm since I do this pretty much every night.
lines.zh: : 我几乎每天都跑，慢一晚上也没什么影响。

lines.en: : And I'm assuming it's too late for me to back out?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，现在想退出也晚了吧？

lines.en: scene momentsredux5
: You got that right. You're stuck with me 'til we're out of breath, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你说对了。在我俩都喘不上气之前，你都甩不掉我，Sensei。

lines.en: Little does Miku know, there are plenty of things we could be doing within the safety of her room that would cause us to run out of breath.
lines.zh: Miku 不知道的是，在她房间那个安全的环境里，我们有的是能让人喘不上气的事可做。

lines.en: But I guess a little sacrifice like this won't kill me every now and then.
lines.zh: 不过我想，偶尔做点这样的牺牲也死不了。

lines.en: She seems excited, so...the least I can do is try to be excited with her and fail miserably.
lines.zh: 她看起来很兴奋，所以……我至少该试着陪她一起兴奋，然后惨败。

lines.en: scene momentsredux7
: Okay! You ready to go? All stretched out?
lines.zh: : 好！准备出发了吗？拉伸完了吗？

lines.en: : Let's just get this over with...
lines.zh: : 赶紧开始吧……

lines.en: scene black
Miku moves to my side and gets into that position track team members take right before they begin a race.
lines.zh: Miku 挪到我身边，摆出了田径队员在起跑前会摆的那个姿势。

lines.en: I’m not sure if there’s a name for it or not...but whatever it’s called, it’s certainly intimidating.
lines.zh: 我不确定那个姿势叫什么……不过不管叫什么，它确实很有压迫感。

lines.en: : You’re not gonna start sprinting right out of the gate, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会一上来就冲刺吧？

lines.en: : ‘Course not! It just feels cool when you start like this!
lines.zh: : 当然不会！只是这样起跑感觉很帅！

lines.en: : You should try it! Come on! Just bend your knees like this and-
lines.zh: : 你也试试！来嘛！像这样弯膝盖，然后——

lines.en: Miku, still hunched over and ready to take off, starts pushing against the backs of my knees, trying to force me into the potentially unnamed track position as well.
lines.zh: Miku 仍然弓着身子、蓄势待发，开始推我的膝弯，试图把我也按进那个大概没有名字的起跑姿势里。

lines.en: Not wanting to fall, I oblige and crouch down- very likely looking like an idiot.
lines.zh: 为了不摔倒，我照做了，蹲了下来——八成看起来蠢极了。

lines.en: : Okay! On three...Ready?
lines.zh: : 好！数到三……准备好了吗？

lines.en: I take a deep breath and stare at the empty street before me.
lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，凝视着眼前空荡荡的街道。

lines.en: There's no one here but us.
lines.zh: 这里除了我们，一个人也没有。

lines.en: menu:
I'm ready
lines.zh: 我准备好了

lines.en: scene nightsky
: Let’s do this.
lines.zh: : 开始吧。

lines.en: : That’s the spirit! Okay-
lines.zh: : 就是这股劲儿！好——

lines.en: : GO!
And just like that, we’re off.
lines.zh: 就这样，我们出发了。

lines.en: Well...{i}off{/i} probably isn't the best word to use since we start with a light jog as I try to remember how running works.
lines.zh: 嗯……{i}「出发」{/i}大概不是最贴切的词，因为我们是以慢跑开始的——我还在努力回忆跑步到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: I can't remember the last time I did anything this physical, so it's a little hard at first...but seeing just how much I'm slowing down Miku motivates me to go a little faster.
lines.zh: 我不记得自己上一次做这么剧烈的运动是什么时候了，所以一开始有点吃力……不过看到我把 Miku 拖慢了多少，倒是激励我跑快一点。

lines.en: Slowly but surely, I begin to pick up the pace.
lines.zh: 慢慢地，但确实地，我开始加速。

lines.en: And within a few minutes, I reach what is {i}probably{/i} my top speed...
lines.zh: 几分钟之后，我就达到了{i}大概是{/i}我的最高速度……

lines.en: scene momentsredux8
: You’re doin’ great, Sensei! Much better than I thought you'd be!
lines.zh: : 你做得很好啊，Sensei！比我预想的好太多了！

lines.en: : Is that...some kind of...joke?
lines.zh: : 那是……某种……笑话吗？

lines.en: : No way! I really mean it!
lines.zh: : 才不是！我是真心的！

lines.en: : Sure, you're runnin’ out of breath and your face is gettin’ kinda red, but you’re still goin’ strong! I’m proud!
lines.zh: : 没错，你喘不上气了，脸也有点红，可你还在坚持！我为你骄傲！

lines.en: It’s true that I’ve been able to {i}mostly{/i} keep up with Miku so far, but...
lines.zh: 到目前为止我确实{i}基本{/i}跟上了 Miku，不过……

lines.en: Well, let’s just say I’m feeling like I could pass out at any moment.
lines.zh: 嗯，这么说吧，我觉得自己随时可能昏过去。

lines.en: I’m not sure if I’ll ever do this again, but I’m definitely glad that I didn’t make myself look like a {i}complete{/i} idiot tonight...
lines.zh: 我不确定自己还会不会再跑一次，但今晚我确实很高兴没有把自己弄得像个{i}彻头彻尾{/i}的傻瓜……

lines.en: scene momentsredux9
: Oh! Turn left up here! This path is a lot easier for beginners. Just a bunch of really long streets and stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦！在这儿左转！这条路对新手友好多了。就是一长串特别长的街道什么的。

lines.en: : How...can you...still talk in...complete sentences?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么……还能……用完整的句子说话？……

lines.en: scene momentsredux8
: Cause I’m having fun!
lines.zh: : 因为我开心啊！

lines.en: scene black
Miku instinctively picks up the pace as the two of us round the corner, but she slows down once again when she realizes I can’t keep up.
lines.zh: 我们转过拐角时，Miku 本能地加快了速度，可一发现我跟不上，她又慢了下来。

lines.en: At least she was telling the truth about this route being a series of really long streets.
lines.zh: 至少她说这条路线是一连串特别长的街道，这话是真的。

lines.en: I can’t even see the ends of them.
lines.zh: 我连它们的尽头都看不见。

lines.en: It’s almost like they go on forever.
lines.zh: 简直像是永远没有尽头。

lines.en: : Okay! Let’s stop here for now. You look like you could use a break...
lines.zh: : 好！我们先在这里停一下吧。你看起来需要休息……

lines.en: scene mikusweat1
: You were totally great tonight, Sensei! I’m super surprised!
lines.zh: : 你今晚真的太棒了，Sensei！我超级惊讶！

lines.en: : You didn’t ask to stop even once!
lines.zh: : 你一次都没喊停！

lines.en: scene mikusweat2
: You know I'm never going to do this again, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我再也不会干这种事了，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, I kinda figured.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我大概猜到了。

lines.en: : Are you okay, though? You’re looking awfully...flushed right now.
lines.zh: : 不过你还好吗？你现在看起来脸色……特别红。

lines.en: scene mikusweat3
: Mhm! I’m totally fine. I always get kinda red when I do stuff like this.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！我完全没事。我做这种事的时候总是会有点脸红。

lines.en: : That’s just how my body works, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概我的身体就是这样吧。

lines.en: : But I could totally run another three or four miles if ya want!
lines.zh: : 不过要是你想，我完全可以再跑个三四英里！

lines.en: : I don't.
lines.zh: : 我不想。

lines.en: scene mikusweat4
: Heheh...I figured. And I ain't tryin’ to break your legs tonight, so we can just hang out here until ya catch your breath.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我就知道。而且我今晚也不想弄断你的腿，那我们就在这儿待着，等你喘匀气吧。

lines.en: : Sounds good to me. I'll probably be good to go again...maybe sometime next year?
lines.zh: : 正合我意。我大概能再跑一次……也许明年什么时候？

lines.en: scene mikusweat5
: That’s fine...
lines.zh: : 没关系……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind hangin’ out with you for another year or so.
lines.zh: : 再跟你相处个一年左右的，我都没意见。

lines.en: : Maybe even longer.
lines.zh: : 也许还能更久。

lines.en: : Sure, Makoto might miss me, but...
lines.zh: : 当然，Makoto 可能会想我，不过……

lines.en: : I don't know.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。

lines.en: : I kinda wish...moments like this would last forever.
lines.zh: : 我有点希望……这样的时刻能永远持续下去。

lines.en: : It’s not often I get this hyped up outside of the soccer field.
lines.zh: : 除了足球场上，我很少这么兴奋。

lines.en: : Is that weird?
lines.zh: : 这很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : All we did was some light jogging and it feels like my heart is about to explode.
lines.zh: : 我们只是慢跑了一下，我却觉得心脏快要炸开了。

lines.en: : I don’t get it...
lines.zh: : 我不明白……
: 是不是……

lines.en: : Is that goin' on with yours as well, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你的心脏也这样吗？

lines.en: scene mikusweat5r
: Sure...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: Of course my heart is beating fast, but not for the same reasons Miku's is.
lines.zh: 我的心跳当然很快，但原因和 Miku 的不一样。

lines.en: She's accustomed to running long distances- and her heart has been conditioned for this type of beating.
lines.zh: 她习惯了长跑——她的心脏已经为这种跳动做好了准备。

lines.en: What it is not conditioned for is the onslaught of emotions flooding into her each time the two of us are alone.
lines.zh: 它没有准备好应付的，是每次我们两个独处时涌入她心头的那股情绪洪流。

lines.en: But me?
lines.zh: 而我呢？

lines.en: I am the inverse.
lines.zh: 我正好相反。

lines.en: My heart is not capable of shrugging off the immense physical strain brought on by running for miles.
lines.zh: 我的心脏无法对跑上几英里带来的巨大身体负荷泰然处之。

lines.en: But it {i}is{/i} capable of shrugging off everything else.
lines.zh: 但它{i}能{/i}对除此之外的一切泰然处之。

lines.en: scene mikusweat6
: Umm...Silence is kinda weird, so I’m gonna keep talkin’, okay?
lines.zh: : 嗯……沉默有点奇怪，那我就继续说啦，好吗？

lines.en: : Sure. If that's what you want to do, do it.
lines.zh: : 当然。你想说就说吧。

lines.en: : Got it...So, like-
lines.zh: : 好……那，就是——

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I guess...thanks for hangin’ out with me and stuff tonight?
lines.zh: : 我想说……谢谢你今晚陪我出来什么的？

lines.en: : I’m sure you wanted to stay inside instead, but I’m glad I got to give you a little taste of my world.
lines.zh: : 你肯定更想待在屋里，不过我很高兴能让你稍微尝一尝我世界的滋味。

lines.en: : It's probably obvious to you by now, but I’ve always loved running.
lines.zh: : 你现在大概已经看出来了，我一直都很喜欢跑步。

lines.en: : It’s like...
lines.zh: : 它就像……

lines.en: scene mikusweat7
: Okay, so this is gonna sound dumb-
lines.zh: : 好吧，这听起来可能很蠢——

lines.en: : But it’s almost like it's the only time I ever feel {i}alive{/i} you know?
lines.zh: : 但它几乎就像是我唯一觉得自己真正{i}活着{/i}的时候，你懂吗？

lines.en: : Every other moment is kinda like...I’m just waitin’ for somethin’ to happen.
lines.zh: : 其他所有时刻都像是……我只是在等着什么事情发生。

lines.en: : And it seems like lotsa things have been happenin’ lately.
lines.zh: : 而最近似乎发生了很多事。

lines.en: : I’m like...actually excited to get out of bed again! And not just to go to soccer practice and see my friends, but...
lines.zh: : 我……又开始真的期待起床了！而且不只是为了去足球训练、见朋友们，还有……

lines.en: : I guess the easiest way to say this is that a lot of the way I've been feelin' lately is thanks to you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我想最简单的说法就是：我最近的这些感受，有很大程度上都要归功于你，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’ve barely even done anything. I’m just following you around and letting you be yourself.
lines.zh: : 我几乎什么都没做。只是跟在你身后，让你做你自己而已。

lines.en: scene mikusweat8
: Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……

lines.en: : Maybe that’s all I needed?
lines.zh: : 也许我要的就只是这个？

lines.en: The two of us sit there, catching our breath and watching cars pass us by for a good twenty minutes or so.
lines.zh: 我们两个坐在那里喘气，看着汽车一辆辆驶过，就这样待了大约二十分钟。

lines.en: Scattered moments of awkward silence are dropped into the mixture every so often, turning this outing into a strange concoction of melancholic contemplation and...
lines.zh: 零星的尴尬沉默时不时掺进其中，把这次出行变成了一剂由忧郁的沉思与……混合而成的奇怪汤药。

lines.en: And a sensation I may be confusing for nostalgia.
lines.zh: 以及一种我可能误认作怀旧的感觉。

lines.en: This feels...familiar for some reason.
lines.zh: 这感觉……莫名地熟悉。

lines.en: scene nightsky
I wonder how many nights I spent in my past life sitting on the sides of roads with sweat dripping down my face?
lines.zh: 我想知道，在上一段人生里，我有多少个夜晚坐在路旁，汗水顺着脸颊往下淌？

lines.en: I wonder what I did at all?
lines.zh: 我想知道，我到底做过些什么？

lines.en: This wasn't what I was like, was it?
lines.zh: 我从前不是这个样子的，对吧？

lines.en: And, if it was, why does the idea of doing something like this now not ring out to me like a bell in a far off tower?
lines.zh: 而如果从前的我是这样，那为什么现在做这种事的念头，没有像远方塔楼里的钟声一样在我心里回响？

lines.en: Something pops into my head.
lines.zh: 有什么东西突然跳进我的脑海。

lines.en: It's a poem.
lines.zh: 是一首诗。

lines.en: if firsttimelibrary == True:
And it’s one you might recognize from Futaba’s textbook.
lines.zh: 而且你可能会认出，它就出自 Futaba 的课本。

lines.en: It goes-
lines.zh: 它是这样写的——

lines.en: ‘There are days we live as if death were nowhere in the background-’
lines.zh: ‘有些日子，我们活着，仿佛死亡根本不在背景之中——’

lines.en: ‘From joy to joy; from wing to wing-’
lines.zh: ‘从欢愉到欢愉；从羽翼到羽翼——’

lines.en: ‘There are days we live as if death were nowhere in the background-’
lines.zh: ‘有些日子，我们活着，仿佛死亡根本不在背景之中——’

lines.en: Something...somewhere inside of me tells me I used to believe poems were just strings of random words...tied haphazardly together to create something that sounded nice but meant nothing.
lines.zh: 我内心深处的某个地方告诉我，我曾经以为诗不过是一串串随机的词……被胡乱串在一起，堆出某种听起来悦耳却毫无意义的东西。

lines.en: But now?
lines.zh: 可现在呢？

lines.en: Now, I believe the opposite.
lines.zh: 现在，我的看法完全相反了。

lines.en: Now-
lines.zh: 现在——

lines.en: Poems all sound horrible to me.
lines.zh: 所有的诗在我听来都可怕至极。

lines.en: Now-
lines.zh: 现在——

lines.en: Now, they just hurt.
lines.zh: 现在，它们只会让人痛。

lines.en: scene black
Miku and I went home shortly after that.
lines.zh: 那之后不久，Miku 和我就回家了。

lines.en: She hugged me on the steps of the dorm.
lines.zh: 她在宿舍的台阶上抱了我。

lines.en: She did not invite me inside.
lines.zh: 她没有邀请我进去。
